#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Extract per-step eval trajectories from wandb offline runs."""

import json
import re
import csv
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict

from wandb.sdk.internal.datastore import DataStore
from wandb.proto import wandb_internal_pb2 as pb

WANDB_DIR = Path("/root/structfuse/wandb")
OUTPUT_DIR = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/artifacts/neg_difficulty_analysis")
OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def parse_run_config(debug_log_path):
    config = {}
    with open(debug_log_path) as f:
        for line in f:
            if "config_cb" in line and "wandb_run_name" in line:
                match = re.search(r"\{.*\}", line)
                if match:
                    try:
                        config = eval(match.group())
                    except:
                        pass
                break
    return config

def identify_model(config):
    model_name = config.get("model_name", "")
    if "qwen" in model_name.lower() or "Qwen" in model_name:
        return "Qwen"
    elif "starcoder" in model_name.lower():
        return "StarCoder"
    return "unknown"

def extract_history(run_dir):
    """Extract all history records from a wandb offline run."""
    run_dir = Path(run_dir)
    wandb_files = list(run_dir.glob("run-*.wandb"))
    if not wandb_files:
        return []

    ds = DataStore()
    ds.open_for_scan(str(wandb_files[0]))

    history = []
    while True:
        data = ds.scan_data()
        if data is None:
            break

        record = pb.Record()
        try:
            record.ParseFromString(data)
        except:
            continue

        control = record.WhichOneof("record_type")
        if control == "history":
            row = {}
            for item in record.history.item:
                # nested_key is a repeated string field (list)
                if item.nested_key:
                    key = ".".join(item.nested_key)
                elif item.key:
                    key = item.key
                else:
                    continue
                if item.value_json:
                    try:
                        row[key] = json.loads(item.value_json)
                    except:
                        pass
            if row:
                history.append(row)

    return history


def main():
    print("=== Extracting eval trajectories from wandb offline runs ===\n")

    run_dirs = sorted(WANDB_DIR.glob("offline-run-*"))
    print(f"Found {len(run_dirs)} offline runs\n")

    all_rows = []
    best_runs = {}

    for run_dir in run_dirs:
        print(f"Processing: {run_dir.name}")

        debug_log = run_dir / "logs" / "debug.log"
        config = {}
        if debug_log.exists():
            config = parse_run_config(debug_log)

        model = identify_model(config)
        strategy = config.get("hard_negative_strategy", "unknown")
        seed = config.get("seed", -1)
        run_name = config.get("wandb_run_name", run_dir.name)

        print(f"  model={model}, strategy={strategy}, seed={seed}, run_name={run_name}")

        history = extract_history(run_dir)
        print(f"  Total history records: {len(history)}")

        # Separate eval records from training records
        eval_records = []
        for row in history:
            if "val_loss" in row or "recall@1" in row:
                eval_records.append(row)

        print(f"  Eval records: {len(eval_records)}")

        if eval_records:
            first = eval_records[0]
            last = eval_records[-1]
            print(f"  First eval (step {first.get('_step', '?')}): "
                  f"val_loss={first.get('val_loss', '?')}, "
                  f"R@1={first.get('recall@1', '?')}")
            print(f"  Last eval (step {last.get('_step', '?')}): "
                  f"val_loss={last.get('val_loss', '?')}, "
                  f"R@1={last.get('recall@1', '?')}")
        elif history:
            all_keys = set()
            for r in history:
                all_keys.update(r.keys())
            print(f"  Keys found: {sorted(all_keys)}")
            # Show a sample
            for r in history[:2]:
                print(f"    Sample: {r}")

        # Keep best run per combo
        key = (model, strategy, seed)
        if key not in best_runs or len(eval_records) > len(best_runs[key][1]):
            best_runs[key] = (run_dir, eval_records, run_name)

        print()

    # Build CSV from best runs
    for (model, strategy, seed), (run_dir, eval_records, run_name) in sorted(best_runs.items()):
        for rec in eval_records:
            step = rec.get("_step", -1)
            all_rows.append({
                "model": model,
                "strategy": strategy,
                "seed": seed,
                "step": step,
                "eval_loss": rec.get("val_loss", ""),
                "recall_at_1": rec.get("recall@1", ""),
                "recall_at_5": rec.get("recall@5", ""),
                "recall_at_10": rec.get("recall@10", ""),
                "mrr": rec.get("mrr", ""),
                "run_name": run_name,
            })

    # Write CSV
    csv_path = OUTPUT_DIR / "eval_trajectories.csv"
    if all_rows:
        fieldnames = ["model", "strategy", "seed", "step", "eval_loss",
                       "recall_at_1", "recall_at_5", "recall_at_10", "mrr", "run_name"]
        with open(csv_path, "w", newline="") as f:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fieldnames)
            writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerows(all_rows)
        print(f"Wrote {len(all_rows)} eval records to {csv_path}")
    else:
        print("No eval records found!")

    # Summary
    print(f"\n=== Summary ===")
    print(f"Total runs: {len(run_dirs)}")
    print(f"Unique combos: {len(best_runs)}")
    print(f"Total eval rows: {len(all_rows)}")

    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for row in all_rows:
        key = f"{row['model']}_{row['strategy']}_s{row['seed']}"
        groups[key].append(row)

    for key in sorted(groups):
        rows = groups[key]
        steps = [r["step"] for r in rows]
        r1_vals = [r["recall_at_1"] for r in rows if r["recall_at_1"] != ""]
        line = f"  {key}: {len(rows)} evals, steps {min(steps)}-{max(steps)}"
        if r1_vals:
            best_r1 = max(r1_vals)
            last_r1 = r1_vals[-1]
            best_idx = r1_vals.index(best_r1)
            best_step = [r["step"] for r in rows if r["recall_at_1"] != ""][best_idx]
            line += f", best R@1={best_r1:.4f}@step{best_step}, last R@1={last_r1:.4f}"
        print(line)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Plot overfitting mechanism analysis:
  Panel A: R@1 training curves (Qwen top, StarCoder bottom)
  Panel B: Margin vs overfitting rate scatter
"""

import csv
import json
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict
from scipy import stats

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D

OUTPUT_DIR = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/artifacts/neg_difficulty_analysis")
CSV_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / "eval_trajectories.csv"

# ---------- Style ----------
plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["Times New Roman", "DejaVu Serif"],
    "font.size": 12,
    "axes.linewidth": 1.2,
    "xtick.major.width": 1.0,
    "ytick.major.width": 1.0,
    "xtick.labelsize": 12,
    "ytick.labelsize": 12,
    "axes.labelsize": 14,
    "legend.fontsize": 11,
    "figure.dpi": 150,
})

STRATEGY_COLORS = {
    "random": "#1f77b4",            # blue
    "embedding_distance": "#ff7f0e", # orange
    "dataflow_aware": "#2ca02c",     # green
}
STRATEGY_LABELS = {
    "random": "Random",
    "embedding_distance": "Embedding",
    "dataflow_aware": "Dataflow",
}
SEED_STYLES = {42: "-", 43: "--", 44: "-."}

# Difficulty data (margin_mean from stats_v3_2048.json)
MARGIN_DATA = {
    "Qwen": {
        "random": 0.0743,
        "embedding_distance": 0.0170,
        "dataflow_aware": 0.0293,
    },
    "StarCoder": {
        "random": 0.194,
        "embedding_distance": 0.067,
        "dataflow_aware": 0.1192,
    },
}


def load_data():
    """Load eval trajectories CSV."""
    data = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(list))
    with open(CSV_PATH) as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f)
        for row in reader:
            model = row["model"]
            strategy = row["strategy"]
            seed = int(row["seed"])
            step = int(row["step"])
            r1 = float(row["recall_at_1"]) if row["recall_at_1"] else None
            vloss = float(row["eval_loss"]) if row["eval_loss"] else None
            key = (model, strategy, seed)
            data[key]["steps"].append(step)
            data[key]["r1"].append(r1)
            data[key]["vloss"].append(vloss)
            data[key]["model"] = model
            data[key]["strategy"] = strategy
            data[key]["seed"] = seed
    return data


def compute_overfitting_rate(steps, r1_vals):
    """
    Overfitting rate = (best_R@1 - R@1_at_last_eval) / (last_step - best_step)
    in units of pp per 100 steps.
    Returns (rate, best_r1, best_step, last_r1, last_step).
    """
    valid = [(s, r) for s, r in zip(steps, r1_vals) if r is not None]
    if len(valid) < 2:
        return None, None, None, None, None

    best_r1 = max(r for _, r in valid)
    best_step = min(s for s, r in valid if r == best_r1)
    last_step = valid[-1][0]
    last_r1 = valid[-1][1]

    if last_step <= best_step:
        return 0.0, best_r1, best_step, last_r1, last_step

    # Rate in percentage points per 100 steps
    rate = (best_r1 - last_r1) / (last_step - best_step) * 100 * 100
    return rate, best_r1, best_step, last_r1, last_step


def plot_panel_a(axes, data):
    """Panel A: R@1 training curves."""
    for ax_idx, (ax, model) in enumerate(zip(axes, ["Qwen", "StarCoder"])):
        for (m, strategy, seed), info in sorted(data.items()):
            if m != model:
                continue
            steps = info["steps"]
            r1 = info["r1"]
            valid = [(s, r) for s, r in zip(steps, r1) if r is not None]
            if not valid:
                continue

            s_arr, r_arr = zip(*sorted(valid))
            color = STRATEGY_COLORS.get(strategy, "gray")
            ls = SEED_STYLES.get(seed, "-")
            alpha = 1.0 if ls == "-" else 0.6
            lw = 2.0 if ls == "-" else 1.5

            ax.plot(s_arr, r_arr, color=color, linestyle=ls, linewidth=lw,
                    alpha=alpha, marker="o", markersize=5)

        ax.set_ylabel("Eval R@1")
        ax.set_title(model, fontsize=14, fontweight="bold", pad=8)
        ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
        ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
        ax.set_xlim(left=0)

    axes[-1].set_xlabel("Training Step")

    # Legend
    legend_elements = []
    for strat in ["random", "embedding_distance", "dataflow_aware"]:
        if any(info["strategy"] == strat for info in data.values()):
            legend_elements.append(
                Line2D([0], [0], color=STRATEGY_COLORS[strat], linewidth=2,
                       label=STRATEGY_LABELS[strat])
            )
    for seed, ls in SEED_STYLES.items():
        legend_elements.append(
            Line2D([0], [0], color="gray", linestyle=ls, linewidth=1.5,
                   label=f"seed={seed}")
        )
    axes[0].legend(handles=legend_elements, loc="upper right", frameon=False)


def plot_panel_b(ax, data):
    """Panel B: Margin vs overfitting rate scatter."""
    MODEL_MARKERS = {"Qwen": "o", "StarCoder": "^"}
    MODEL_SIZES = {"Qwen": 100, "StarCoder": 100}

    points_x = []
    points_y = []
    labels = []

    for (model, strategy, seed), info in sorted(data.items()):
        rate, best_r1, best_step, last_r1, last_step = compute_overfitting_rate(
            info["steps"], info["r1"]
        )
        if rate is None:
            continue

        margin = MARGIN_DATA.get(model, {}).get(strategy)
        if margin is None:
            continue

        color = STRATEGY_COLORS.get(strategy, "gray")
        marker = MODEL_MARKERS.get(model, "o")
        size = MODEL_SIZES.get(model, 80)

        ax.scatter(margin, rate, c=color, marker=marker, s=size,
                   edgecolors="black", linewidth=0.8, zorder=5)

        points_x.append(margin)
        points_y.append(rate)
        labels.append(f"{model[:1]}-{strategy[:3]}-s{seed}")

        print(f"  {model} {strategy} s{seed}: margin={margin:.4f}, "
              f"overfit_rate={rate:.4f} pp/100steps, "
              f"best_R@1={best_r1:.4f}@{best_step}, last_R@1={last_r1:.4f}@{last_step}")

    # Pearson correlation
    if len(points_x) >= 3:
        r_val, p_val = stats.pearsonr(points_x, points_y)
        print(f"\n  Pearson r = {r_val:.4f}, p = {p_val:.4f}")

        # Fit line
        z = np.polyfit(points_x, points_y, 1)
        x_line = np.linspace(min(points_x) * 0.8, max(points_x) * 1.2, 100)
        y_line = np.polyval(z, x_line)
        ax.plot(x_line, y_line, "k--", linewidth=1, alpha=0.5)

        # Annotation
        ax.text(0.05, 0.95, f"r = {r_val:.3f}\np = {p_val:.3f}",
                transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=11,
                verticalalignment="top", fontfamily="serif",
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.3", facecolor="wheat", alpha=0.5))

    ax.set_xlabel("Pretrained Margin (mean)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Overfitting Rate (pp / 100 steps)")
    ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)

    # Legend for model markers
    legend_elements = [
        Line2D([0], [0], marker="o", color="w", markerfacecolor="gray",
               markeredgecolor="black", markersize=10, label="Qwen"),
        Line2D([0], [0], marker="^", color="w", markerfacecolor="gray",
               markeredgecolor="black", markersize=10, label="StarCoder"),
    ]
    for strat in ["random", "embedding_distance", "dataflow_aware"]:
        legend_elements.append(
            Line2D([0], [0], marker="s", color="w",
                   markerfacecolor=STRATEGY_COLORS[strat],
                   markeredgecolor="black", markersize=10,
                   label=STRATEGY_LABELS[strat])
        )
    ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc="upper right", frameon=False, fontsize=10)


def main():
    data = load_data()
    print(f"Loaded {len(data)} unique (model, strategy, seed) combos\n")

    fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 10))
    gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, width_ratios=[3, 2], hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

    # Panel A: top-left and bottom-left
    ax_qwen = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
    ax_sc = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0], sharex=ax_qwen)

    # Panel B: right side spanning both rows
    ax_scatter = fig.add_subplot(gs[:, 1])

    print("=== Panel A: R@1 Training Curves ===")
    plot_panel_a([ax_qwen, ax_sc], data)

    print("\n=== Panel B: Margin vs Overfitting Rate ===")
    plot_panel_b(ax_scatter, data)

    # Panel labels
    ax_qwen.text(-0.08, 1.05, "A", transform=ax_qwen.transAxes,
                 fontsize=18, fontweight="bold")
    ax_scatter.text(-0.08, 1.05, "B", transform=ax_scatter.transAxes,
                    fontsize=18, fontweight="bold")

    fig.tight_layout()

    # Save
    pdf_path = OUTPUT_DIR / "overfitting_mechanism.pdf"
    png_path = OUTPUT_DIR / "overfitting_mechanism.png"
    fig.savefig(pdf_path, bbox_inches="tight")
    fig.savefig(png_path, bbox_inches="tight", dpi=300)
    print(f"\nSaved to:\n  {pdf_path}\n  {png_path}")
    plt.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Overfitting mechanism analysis figure.
  Panel A (left): R@1 eval trajectories (Qwen top, StarCoder bottom)
  Panel B (right): Margin vs eval-loss slope scatter
"""

import csv
import json
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict
from scipy import stats

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from matplotlib.gridspec import GridSpec

OUTPUT_DIR = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/artifacts/neg_difficulty_analysis")
CSV_PATH = OUTPUT_DIR / "eval_trajectories.csv"

# ---------- Style ----------
plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["Times New Roman", "DejaVu Serif"],
    "font.size": 12,
    "axes.linewidth": 1.2,
    "xtick.major.width": 1.0,
    "ytick.major.width": 1.0,
    "xtick.labelsize": 12,
    "ytick.labelsize": 12,
    "axes.labelsize": 14,
    "legend.fontsize": 10,
    "figure.dpi": 150,
})

STRATEGY_COLORS = {
    "random": "#1f77b4",
    "embedding_distance": "#ff7f0e",
    "dataflow_aware": "#2ca02c",
}
STRATEGY_LABELS = {
    "random": "Random",
    "embedding_distance": "Embedding",
    "dataflow_aware": "Dataflow",
}
SEED_STYLES = {42: "-", 43: "--", 44: "-."}

MARGIN_DATA = {
    "Qwen": {"random": 0.0743, "embedding_distance": 0.0170, "dataflow_aware": 0.0293},
    "StarCoder": {"random": 0.194, "embedding_distance": 0.067, "dataflow_aware": 0.1192},
}


def load_data():
    data = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(list))
    with open(CSV_PATH) as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f)
        for row in reader:
            key = (row["model"], row["strategy"], int(row["seed"]))
            data[key]["steps"].append(int(row["step"]))
            data[key]["r1"].append(float(row["recall_at_1"]) if row["recall_at_1"] else None)
            data[key]["vloss"].append(float(row["eval_loss"]) if row["eval_loss"] else None)
            data[key]["model"] = row["model"]
            data[key]["strategy"] = row["strategy"]
            data[key]["seed"] = int(row["seed"])
    return data


def compute_loss_slope(steps, vloss_vals):
    """Linear regression of eval loss vs step. Positive slope = overfitting."""
    valid = [(s, v) for s, v in zip(steps, vloss_vals) if v is not None]
    if len(valid) < 2:
        return None
    s_arr = np.array([x[0] for x in valid])
    v_arr = np.array([x[1] for x in valid])
    slope, _, _, _, _ = stats.linregress(s_arr, v_arr)
    return slope * 1000  # per 1000 steps


def compute_overfitting_metrics(steps, r1_vals, vloss_vals):
    """Compute multiple overfitting indicators."""
    valid_r1 = [(s, r) for s, r in zip(steps, r1_vals) if r is not None]
    valid_loss = [(s, v) for s, v in zip(steps, vloss_vals) if v is not None]
    
    metrics = {}
    
    if len(valid_r1) >= 2:
        best_r1 = max(r for _, r in valid_r1)
        best_step = min(s for s, r in valid_r1 if r == best_r1)
        last_r1 = valid_r1[-1][1]
        last_step = valid_r1[-1][0]
        metrics["best_r1"] = best_r1
        metrics["best_step"] = best_step
        metrics["last_r1"] = last_r1
        metrics["last_step"] = last_step
        if last_step > best_step:
            metrics["r1_drop_rate"] = (best_r1 - last_r1) / (last_step - best_step) * 100 * 100
        else:
            metrics["r1_drop_rate"] = 0.0

    if len(valid_loss) >= 2:
        s_arr = np.array([x[0] for x in valid_loss])
        v_arr = np.array([x[1] for x in valid_loss])
        slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(s_arr, v_arr)
        metrics["loss_slope"] = slope * 1000  # per 1000 steps
        metrics["loss_r2"] = r_value ** 2
    
    return metrics


def plot_panel_a(axes, data):
    for ax, model in zip(axes, ["Qwen", "StarCoder"]):
        for (m, strategy, seed), info in sorted(data.items()):
            if m != model:
                continue
            valid = [(s, r) for s, r in zip(info["steps"], info["r1"]) if r is not None]
            if not valid:
                continue
            s_arr, r_arr = zip(*sorted(valid))
            color = STRATEGY_COLORS.get(strategy, "gray")
            ls = SEED_STYLES.get(seed, "-")
            alpha = 1.0 if ls == "-" else 0.65
            lw = 2.0 if ls == "-" else 1.5
            ax.plot(s_arr, r_arr, color=color, linestyle=ls, linewidth=lw,
                    alpha=alpha, marker="o", markersize=5, markeredgecolor="white",
                    markeredgewidth=0.5)

        ax.set_ylabel("Eval R@1", fontsize=13)
        ax.set_title(model, fontsize=14, fontweight="bold", pad=8)
        ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
        ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
        ax.set_xlim(left=0)
        ax.tick_params(axis="both", which="major", labelsize=11)

    axes[-1].set_xlabel("Training Step", fontsize=13)

    legend_elements = []
    for strat in ["random", "embedding_distance", "dataflow_aware"]:
        if any(info["strategy"] == strat for info in data.values()):
            legend_elements.append(
                Line2D([0], [0], color=STRATEGY_COLORS[strat], linewidth=2.5,
                       label=STRATEGY_LABELS[strat]))
    for seed, ls in SEED_STYLES.items():
        legend_elements.append(
            Line2D([0], [0], color="gray", linestyle=ls, linewidth=1.5,
                   label=f"seed {seed}"))
    axes[0].legend(handles=legend_elements, loc="lower left", frameon=True,
                   fancybox=False, edgecolor="gray", framealpha=0.9, fontsize=9.5)


def plot_panel_b(ax, data):
    """Scatter: margin vs eval-loss slope (positive = loss increasing = overfitting)."""
    MODEL_MARKERS = {"Qwen": "o", "StarCoder": "^"}

    points_x = []
    points_y = []

    print("\nPanel B data points:")
    for (model, strategy, seed), info in sorted(data.items()):
        metrics = compute_overfitting_metrics(info["steps"], info["r1"], info["vloss"])
        if "loss_slope" not in metrics:
            continue

        margin = MARGIN_DATA.get(model, {}).get(strategy)
        if margin is None:
            continue

        loss_slope = metrics["loss_slope"]
        color = STRATEGY_COLORS.get(strategy, "gray")
        marker = MODEL_MARKERS.get(model, "o")

        ax.scatter(margin, loss_slope, c=color, marker=marker, s=120,
                   edgecolors="black", linewidth=0.8, zorder=5)

        points_x.append(margin)
        points_y.append(loss_slope)

        print(f"  {model} {strategy} s{seed}: margin={margin:.4f}, "
              f"loss_slope={loss_slope:.4f}/1k steps, "
              f"best_R@1={metrics.get('best_r1', '?'):.4f}@{metrics.get('best_step', '?')}, "
              f"last_R@1={metrics.get('last_r1', '?'):.4f}@{metrics.get('last_step', '?')}")

    if len(points_x) >= 3:
        r_val, p_val = stats.pearsonr(points_x, points_y)
        sp_r, sp_p = stats.spearmanr(points_x, points_y)
        print(f"\n  Pearson  r = {r_val:.4f}, p = {p_val:.4f}")
        print(f"  Spearman ρ = {sp_r:.4f}, p = {sp_p:.4f}")

        z = np.polyfit(points_x, points_y, 1)
        x_line = np.linspace(min(points_x) - 0.01, max(points_x) + 0.01, 100)
        y_line = np.polyval(z, x_line)
        ax.plot(x_line, y_line, "k--", linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.4, zorder=1)

        ax.text(0.05, 0.95,
                f"Pearson r = {r_val:.2f}\n(p = {p_val:.2f})\n"
                f"Spearman ρ = {sp_r:.2f}\n(p = {sp_p:.2f})",
                transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=10,
                verticalalignment="top", fontfamily="serif",
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.4", facecolor="lightyellow",
                          edgecolor="gray", alpha=0.85))

    ax.set_xlabel("Pretrained Margin (mean)", fontsize=13)
    ax.set_ylabel("Eval Loss Slope (per 1k steps)", fontsize=13)
    ax.axhline(0, color="gray", linewidth=0.5, linestyle=":", alpha=0.5)
    ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
    ax.tick_params(axis="both", which="major", labelsize=11)

    legend_elements = [
        Line2D([0], [0], marker="o", color="w", markerfacecolor="gray",
               markeredgecolor="black", markersize=10, label="Qwen"),
        Line2D([0], [0], marker="^", color="w", markerfacecolor="gray",
               markeredgecolor="black", markersize=10, label="StarCoder"),
    ]
    for strat in ["random", "embedding_distance", "dataflow_aware"]:

            legend_elements.append(

                       markerfacecolor=STRATEGY_COLORS[strat],

                       label=STRATEGY_LABELS[strat]))
    ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc="lower right", frameon=True,
              fancybox=False, edgecolor="gray", framealpha=0.9, fontsize=9)


def main():
    data = load_data()
    print(f"Loaded {len(data)} unique (model, strategy, seed) combos")

    fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 9), constrained_layout=True)
    gs = GridSpec(2, 2, figure=fig, width_ratios=[1.4, 1], height_ratios=[1, 1],
                  hspace=0.25, wspace=0.25)

    ax_qwen = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
    ax_sc = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
    ax_scatter = fig.add_subplot(gs[:, 1])

    print("\n=== Panel A: R@1 Training Curves ===")
    plot_panel_a([ax_qwen, ax_sc], data)

    print("\n=== Panel B: Margin vs Loss Slope ===")
    plot_panel_b(ax_scatter, data)

    ax_qwen.text(-0.12, 1.08, "A", transform=ax_qwen.transAxes,
                 fontsize=20, fontweight="bold", va="top")
    ax_scatter.text(-0.12, 1.04, "B", transform=ax_scatter.transAxes,
                    fontsize=20, fontweight="bold", va="top")

    pdf_path = OUTPUT_DIR / "overfitting_mechanism.pdf"
    png_path = OUTPUT_DIR / "overfitting_mechanism.png"
    fig.savefig(pdf_path, bbox_inches="tight")
